| description = "They struck from the water like the arms of Cazic-Thule. With a single bite, our cleric was paralyzed by a serpent's blinding venom. His screams vaulted through the cursed caverns of the Dragon Necropolis. I waded forward through the stagnant pool, slashing at their tough, scaly skin and crying out to my party to immobilize our serpentine foes; but their bite was too powerful...

By the time my own sight restored, every member of the expedition lay on the ground, slain, their flesh swollen and distended by the noxious venoms. Then, I felt the raspy of scales wind about my neck and heard the hideous report of my spine snapping."

- The Journal of Filbus Furyfoot, Lord of the Misty Thicket

Will cast [[Blinding Poison III]], a blind that can last for 1.7 minutes, from well outside melee range. Use cure poison or cure blindness to cure it.
